narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent! I'll get the crew to work right away on the parts we'll need for the next race.
narrative.requestItemsText:
I'd like to integrate indurium into different parts of our racers, but I need large amounts of raw indurium to create these parts.

You can find indurium ore in the Uldaman excavation in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan.

The gnomes are getting their own supply of it, so it's important we get our own to keep pace with them.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 35 to 42, 9,100 XP in all.

quests.name: Martek the Exiled
quests.objectiveText: Bring Fizzle's Letter to Martek the Exiled in the Badlands.

quests.name: Indurium
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Indurium Flakes to Martek the Exiled in the Badlands.

quests.name: News for Fizzle
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.

quests.name: Keeping Pace
quests.objectiveText: Have Zamek create a diversion, then steal Rizzle's plans for Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.

quests.name: Rizzle's Schematics
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Sample of Indurium Ore to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
